English: Ancestor Pole
A sacred wooden pole adorned with ancestral carvings, serving as a focal point for clan gatherings and traditions.
Spirit Stand
A simple wooden stand holding tokens and relics believed to house the spirits of ancestors, drawing the clan together.
Totem Pavilion
A sturdy canvas pavilion encircling totems and ritual objects, offering shelter for ceremonies and strengthening unity.
Priests Room
A secure mud-and-thatch chamber reserved for the clans spiritual leader, where rituals and blessings are prepared.
Blessed Hut
A revered hut constructed from fine wood and clay, adorned with sacred emblems and guarded by elders. Only accessible by those deemed worthy.
Ritual Chamber
A spacious, ornately decorated earthen chamber, equipped for grand ceremonies and rites to unite the entire clan.
Sanctuary Pavilion
A fortified pavilion at the heart of the camp, where clan leaders and spiritual elders gather to resolve disputes and set policy.
Diviners Hall
A grand hall of carved hardwood and painted mud, where wise diviners consult spirits to guide the clans destiny.
Holy Room
The most revered structure, this sanctum is the spiritual heart of the clan, where major decisions are ratified in solemn ritual.
Central African Ritual Hut
A legendary structure, its very presence cements the unity of all clans, granting unmatched prestige and clan sentiment to the ruler.
